message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference calendar showing **all federally recognised “statutory” holidays** that created *at least one* extra day off around a weekend during 2023 in Canada.  
(If a holiday fell on a weekend, the government usually moved the observance to the nearest weekday—most often the following Monday.)

| Date | Holiday | Weekday | Observed On | Long Weekend Result |
|------|---------|--------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 01** | New Year's Day | Sun | — | No paid day off (but most employers close); the *next working day* (Mon 02) is treated as a holiday by many companies. |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day *(BC, AB, SK, NB)* | Mon | — | **Long weekend:** Sat 18–Sun 19 + Mon 20 |
| **Apr 07** | Good Friday | Fri | — | **Long weekend:** Fri 07 + Sat 08–Sun 09 |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Mon | — | **Long weekend:** Sat 20–Sun 21 + Mon 22 |
| **Jul 03** | Canada Day (Observed) | Mon | Because Canada Day was on Sat 01 | **Long weekend:** Sat 01–Sun 02 + Mon 03 |
| **Sep 04** | Labour Day | Mon | — | **Long weekend:** Sat 02–Sun 03 + Mon 04 |
| **Oct 09** | Thanksgiving | Mon | — | **Long weekend:** Sat 07–Sun 08 + Mon 09 |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Mon | — | **Long weekend:** Sat 23–Sun 24 + Mon 25 |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tue | — | **Extended long weekend:** Sat 23–Sun 24 + Mon 25 + Tue 26 |

### Quick Notes

| Province / Territory | Extra Holidays That Can Create Long Weekends |
|-----------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| Ontario | **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mar 17) – optional employer holiday; **Civic Holiday** (Aug 15) – optional; **National Indigenous Peoples Day** (Jun 21) – optional. |
| Québec | **Easter Monday** (April 10) – adds another day after Good Friday. |
| Alberta | **Heritage Days** (June 16) – optional. |
| Manitoba | **Louis Riel Day** (Sept 18) – optional. |
| Saskatchewan | **Saskatchewan Day** (Nov 12) – optional. |
| British Columbia | **British Columbia Day** (Oct 30) – optional. |
| Newfoundland & Labrador | **Mawsonite Day** (July 14) – optional. |
| Nunavut | **Nunavut Day** (Jun 27) – optional. |
| Yukon | **Yukon Day** (Jun 29) – optional. |
| Northwest Territories | **NWT Day** (Jun 28) – optional. |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • Use the above federal schedule as the base.  
> • Add a toggle per region to show optional provincial holidays that could extend a weekend.  
> • Remember that many businesses treat the *“observed”* day (e.g., Canada Day on July 3) as a full holiday even though the legal holiday itself landed on a weekend.

Feel free to let me know if you'd like the same info broken down by each individual province or territory!
